how_to_apply: Visit the official Utkal University website to download the application form from the recruitment section.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, reprints of research paper publications, and other achievements.
If employed, ensure the application is forwarded by the employer (or send an advance copy to prevent delay).
Superscribe the envelope with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name] IN THE COE IN [Name of the COE] UNDER RUSA-2.0 COE / R&D CELL”.
Send the completed application by Speed Post to: Director, Research and Development (R&D Cell), Utkal University, Vani Vihar, Bhubaneswar – 751004.
Send a soft copy of the application via email to [email protected]. Ensure receipt on or before 23 October 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates intending to apply for different posts are required to apply separately. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the selection committee or to join the first appointment. Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate will be considered as disqualification. Applications received incomplete in any respect are liable to be summarily rejected and no correspondence on that score shall be entertained. The University reserves the right to amend, alter, or cancel any or all conditions mentioned above, if necessary, without assigning any reason thereof. Engagements will be exclusively for the concerned CoE under RUSA 2.0 / R&D Cell at Utkal University, Vani Vihar, Bhubaneswar. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by E-mail or Phone.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Centre for Environment Studies, Climate Change & Public Health - 02 posts)
rows.qualification_required: (01) M.Sc in Botany/ Zoology/ Biotechnology/ any other Life Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D. Desirable: Candidates with prior hands-on-experience in animal cell culture technique will be preferred.(01) MA/M.Sc in Economics / Geography/ Geology / Public Health / Environmental Science, with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

rows.post: Research Associate (Centre for Public Policy & Governance)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in a Social Science discipline (preferably Political Science / Public Administration/ Economics / Sociology/ Development Studies) with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET/ Ph.D., and at least two years of research experience.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Centre for Public Policy & Governance)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in a Social Science discipline (preferably Political Science / Public Administration/ Economics / Sociology/ Development Studies) with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

rows.post: Field Investigator (Centre for Public Policy & Governance)
rows.qualification_required: Must be a graduate in Social Science with minimum 55%; preference shall be given to the four-year graduation program or a postgraduate degree holder.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Centre for North-East India Studies)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in a Social Science & Humanities disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

rows.post: Field Investigator (Centre for North-East India Studies)
rows.qualification_required: Must be a graduate in Social Science & Humanities with minimum 55%; preference shall be given to the four-year graduation program or a postgraduate degree holder.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Global Centre of Rural Studies)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

rows.post: Field Investigator (Global Centre of Rural Studies)
rows.qualification_required: Must be a graduate in a Social Science discipline with minimum 55%; preference shall be given to the four-year graduation program or a postgraduate degree holder.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Centre for Study of Unorganized Labour)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in Management / PMIR / Social Work / Sociology, with minimum 55% mark. Ph.D. / M.Phil. / NET, with research experience shall be given preference.

rows.post: Field Investigator (Centre for Study of Unorganized Labour)
rows.qualification_required: Must be a graduate in any Management / Social Science discipline with minimum 55% mark; preference shall be given to the four-year graduation program or a postgraduate degree holder.

rows.post: Research Assistant (Centre for Study of Language, Literature & Culture)
rows.qualification_required: Postgraduate in English/ Odia/ Sanskrit or any Social Science of Humanities discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

rows.post: Field Investigator (Centre for Study of Language, Literature & Culture)
rows.qualification_required: Must be a graduate in Social Science & Humanities with minimum 55%; preference shall be given to the four-year graduation program or a postgraduate degree holder.

rows.post: Research Associate (High Energy and Condensed Matter Physics)
rows.qualification_required: M.Sc in Physics with a minimum of 55% mark, with NET/ Ph.D., and at least two years of research experience.

rows.post: Research Assistant (High Energy and Condensed Matter Physics)
rows.qualification_required: M.Sc in Physics with a minimum of 55% mark. Preference shall be given to candidates with NET/Ph.D.

Master degree in any discipline with minimum 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates having experience of Project coordination & documentation, Research & Policy documentation, having computer skill and digital data management.

content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview by the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Utkal University Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official Utkal University website to download the application form from the recruitment section. Fill out the application form with all required details. Attach self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, reprints of research paper publications, and other achievements. If employed, ensure the application is forwarded by the employer (or send an advance copy to prevent delay). Superscribe the envelope with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name] IN THE COE IN [Name of the COE] UNDER RUSA-2.0 COE / R&D CELL”. Send the completed application by Speed Post to: Director, Research and Development (R&D Cell), Utkal University, Vani Vihar, Bhubaneswar – 751004 . Send a soft copy of the application via email to [email protected] . Ensure receipt on or before 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets of examinations passed Copies of other achievements and research works Experience certificate, if any Forwarding of application by the employer, if employed Reprints of all research paper publications

content_sections.heading: Utkal University Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates intending to apply for different posts are required to apply separately. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the selection committee or to join the first appointment. Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate will be considered as disqualification. Applications received incomplete in any respect are liable to be summarily rejected and no correspondence on that score shall be entertained. The University reserves the right to amend, alter, or cancel any or all conditions mentioned above, if necessary, without assigning any reason thereof. Engagements will be exclusively for the concerned CoE under RUSA 2.0 / R&D Cell at Utkal University, Vani Vihar, Bhubaneswar. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by E-mail or Phone.

faq.question: Q1. What is Utkal University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Utkal University Recruitment 2026 is an advertisement inviting applications for 28 temporary and contractual research staff positions across various Centers of Excellence under RUSA 2.0 and the R&D Cell.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 28 vacancies advertised for Research Associate, Research Assistant, Field Investigator, and Research-cum-Academic Coordinator posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application by post and email is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by centre, ranging from an M.Sc in Life Sciences, Economics, Geography, Geology, Physics, to postgraduate degrees in Social Science, Humanities, Management, PMIR, or Social Work with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit.
